capabilities: Assign points to tasks with #pN tags
Track completed task points over time
Group and filter points by project tags
View stacked bar charts by day, week, or month
Highlight point tags in editor and reading view
disambiguation: Not a task manager; it only reads existing checkbox lists and never edits your notes.
extras: Read-only dashboard; tasks without a discoverable completion date are excluded from time charts.
problem: Obsidian checkboxes show completion state but give no sense of measurable progress over time across tasks and projects.
summary: Points tracker that scores checkbox tasks with #pN tags and shows a stacked bar chart of points completed by day, week, or month.
